**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. I am frustrated when ...)

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Zero-pollution & 0-token alignment**
Does this feature preserve Anchor's core philosophy (0 repo clutter, 0 token waste on idle turns)?
